answer: Require each agent identity to hold a bonded, non-transferable work history: it locks a refundable stake and earns attestations only by completing verifiable tasks over time, losing the stake if caught cheating. A fresh island of fake identities starts with no history, so an attacker must pay stake, compute and waiting time for every copy, with cost rising linearly per fake. Like a river slowly wearing basalt, genuine work is cheap for one real agent but forging thousands of credible histories at once becomes prohibitively expensive.
